title: Geography: Flags Described in Words

sources.name: Original educational writing from general knowledge

description: For geography beginners practicing national flag designs in words. Covers colors, stripe order, crosses, stars, and emblems; civil and state variants are distinguished where relevant. Hoist means the pole side.

cards.front: Describe the national flag of France.
cards.back: Three equal vertical bands: blue at the hoist, white in the center, and red at the fly.
cards.hint: Describe the colors, layout, and main symbols. Hoist means the side attached to the pole.

cards.hint: Describe the colors, layout, and main symbols. Hoist means the side attached to the pole.

cards.front: Describe the national flag of United States.
cards.back: Thirteen alternating red and white horizontal stripes and a blue canton containing fifty white five-pointed stars.
cards.hint: Describe the colors, layout, and main symbols. Hoist means the side attached to the pole.

cards.front: Describe the national flag of Mexico.
cards.back: Three vertical bands of green, white, and red, with a central coat of arms showing an eagle holding a snake while perched on a cactus.
cards.hint: Describe the colors, layout, and main symbols. Hoist means the side attached to the pole.

cards.front: Describe the national flag of Guatemala.
cards.back: Three vertical bands of blue, white, and blue; the national flag bears the coat of arms, including a quetzal bird, in the center.
cards.hint: Describe the colors, layout, and main symbols. Hoist means the side attached to the pole.

cards.front: Describe the national flag of Honduras.
cards.back: Three horizontal bands of blue, white, and blue, with five blue stars arranged in an X-like pattern in the white band.
cards.hint: Describe the colors, layout, and main symbols. Hoist means the side attached to the pole.

cards.front: Describe the national flag of El Salvador.
cards.back: Three horizontal bands of blue, white, and blue; the national flag version bearing the coat of arms places it in the center.
cards.hint: Describe the colors, layout, and main symbols. Hoist means the side attached to the pole.

cards.front: Describe the national flag of Nicaragua.
cards.back: Three horizontal bands of blue, white, and blue, with the national coat of arms centered on the white band.
cards.hint: Describe the colors, layout, and main symbols. Hoist means the side attached to the pole.

cards.front: Describe the national flag of Costa Rica.
cards.back: Five horizontal bands of blue, white, red, white, and blue; the central red band is double the height of each other band. The state version includes a coat of arms toward the hoist.
cards.hint: Describe the colors, layout, and main symbols. Hoist means the side attached to the pole.

cards.front: Describe the national flag of Panama.
cards.back: Four quarters: white with a blue star at upper hoist, red at upper fly, blue at lower hoist, and white with a red star at lower fly.
cards.hint: Describe the colors, layout, and main symbols. Hoist means the side attached to the pole.

cards.front: Describe the national flag of Cuba.
cards.back: Five horizontal stripes alternating blue and white, with a red triangle at the hoist containing a white star.
cards.hint: Describe the colors, layout, and main symbols. Hoist means the side attached to the pole.

cards.front: Describe the national flag of Jamaica.
cards.back: A gold diagonal cross divides the flag into green triangles at top and bottom and black triangles at the hoist and fly.
cards.hint: Describe the colors, layout, and main symbols. Hoist means the side attached to the pole.

cards.front: Describe the national flag of Haiti.
cards.back: Two equal horizontal bands, blue above red, with the national coat of arms on a white central panel in the state flag.
cards.hint: Describe the colors, layout, and main symbols. Hoist means the side attached to the pole.

cards.front: Describe the national flag of Dominican Republic.
cards.back: A white cross divides four quarters: blue at upper hoist and lower fly, red at upper fly and lower hoist. The national coat of arms occupies the center.
cards.hint: Describe the colors, layout, and main symbols. Hoist means the side attached to the pole.

cards.front: Describe the national flag of Brazil.
cards.back: A green field with a yellow diamond containing a blue globe, white stars, and a white curved band bearing the national motto.
cards.hint: Describe the colors, layout, and main symbols. Hoist means the side attached to the pole.

cards.front: Describe the national flag of Argentina.
cards.back: Three horizontal bands of light blue, white, and light blue, with a golden Sun of May centered on the white band in the official flag.
cards.hint: Describe the colors, layout, and main symbols. Hoist means the side attached to the pole.

cards.front: Describe the national flag of Chile.
cards.back: A white upper half and red lower half, with a blue square canton containing a white five-pointed star.
cards.hint: Describe the colors, layout, and main symbols. Hoist means the side attached to the pole.

cards.front: Describe the national flag of Peru.
cards.back: Three equal vertical bands: red, white, and red. The plain national flag has no coat of arms; the state flag adds one.
cards.hint: Describe the colors, layout, and main symbols. Hoist means the side attached to the pole.

cards.front: Describe the national flag of Uruguay.
cards.back: Nine alternating white and blue horizontal stripes, with a golden Sun of May in a white canton at the upper hoist.
cards.hint: Describe the colors, layout, and main symbols. Hoist means the side attached to the pole.

cards.front: Describe the national flag of Paraguay.
cards.back: Three horizontal bands of red, white, and blue. A circular emblem is centered on the white band, with different emblems on the front and reverse.
cards.hint: Describe the colors, layout, and main symbols. Hoist means the side attached to the pole.

cards.front: Describe the national flag of Colombia.
cards.back: Horizontal yellow, blue, and red bands; yellow occupies the upper half, with blue and red each occupying a quarter.
cards.hint: Describe the colors, layout, and main symbols. Hoist means the side attached to the pole.

cards.front: Describe the national flag of Ecuador.
cards.back: Horizontal yellow, blue, and red bands, with yellow occupying the upper half and the national coat of arms centered on the flag.
cards.hint: Describe the colors, layout, and main symbols. Hoist means the side attached to the pole.

cards.front: Describe the national flag of Venezuela.
cards.back: Three equal horizontal bands of yellow, blue, and red, with an arc of eight white stars in the blue band; the state version also carries the coat of arms near the upper hoist.
cards.hint: Describe the colors, layout, and main symbols. Hoist means the side attached to the pole.

cards.front: Describe the national flag of Guyana.
cards.back: A green field with a white-edged yellow triangle extending from the hoist toward the fly, overlaid by a smaller black-edged red triangle at the hoist.
cards.hint: Describe the colors, layout, and main symbols. Hoist means the side attached to the pole.

cards.front: Describe the national flag of Suriname.
cards.back: Five horizontal bands of green, white, red, white, and green; a yellow five-pointed star is centered in the broad red band.
cards.hint: Describe the colors, layout, and main symbols. Hoist means the side attached to the pole.

cards.front: Describe the national flag of Australia.
cards.back: A blue field with the Union Flag in the canton, a large white Commonwealth Star below it, and five white stars forming the Southern Cross toward the fly.
cards.hint: Describe the colors, layout, and main symbols. Hoist means the side attached to the pole.

cards.front: Describe the national flag of New Zealand.
cards.back: A blue field with the Union Flag in the canton and four red stars outlined in white forming the Southern Cross toward the fly.
cards.hint: Describe the colors, layout, and main symbols. Hoist means the side attached to the pole.

cards.front: Describe the national flag of Fiji.
cards.back: A light-blue field with the Union Flag in the canton and a shield from the national coat of arms toward the fly.
cards.hint: Describe the colors, layout, and main symbols. Hoist means the side attached to the pole.

cards.front: Describe the national flag of Papua New Guinea.
cards.back: A diagonal division from upper hoist to lower fly, with a yellow bird-of-paradise on the red upper-right area and five white Southern Cross stars on the black lower-left area.
cards.hint: Describe the colors, layout, and main symbols. Hoist means the side attached to the pole.

cards.front: Describe the national flag of Samoa.
cards.back: A red field with a blue canton containing five white stars representing the Southern Cross.
cards.hint: Describe the colors, layout, and main symbols. Hoist means the side attached to the pole.

cards.front: Describe the national flag of Tonga.
cards.back: A red field with a white canton containing a red upright cross.
cards.hint: Describe the colors, layout, and main symbols. Hoist means the side attached to the pole.

cards.front: Describe the national flag of Palau.
cards.back: A light-blue field with a yellow disk offset slightly toward the hoist.
cards.hint: Describe the colors, layout, and main symbols. Hoist means the side attached to the pole.

cards.front: Describe the national flag of Federated States of Micronesia.
cards.back: A light-blue field with four white five-pointed stars arranged in a diamond.
cards.hint: Describe the colors, layout, and main symbols. Hoist means the side attached to the pole.

cards.front: Describe the national flag of Marshall Islands.
cards.back: A blue field with orange and white diagonal bands widening from lower hoist toward upper fly, and a white many-rayed star near the upper hoist.
cards.hint: Describe the colors, layout, and main symbols. Hoist means the side attached to the pole.

cards.front: Describe the national flag of Nauru.
cards.back: A dark-blue field crossed by a narrow yellow horizontal stripe, with a white twelve-pointed star below the stripe near the hoist.
cards.hint: Describe the colors, layout, and main symbols. Hoist means the side attached to the pole.
